questions.q: What entry criteria triggers Cascade's Opportunity Discount Approval process?
options: Stage equals Closed Won
Discount_Percent__c is greater than 15
Amount is greater than $50,000
Loss_Reason__c is blank
questions.explain: The approval process's entry criteria is Discount_Percent__c > 15 -- any proposed discount past that threshold requires sign-off.

questions.q: What happens to the Opportunity record the moment it's submitted for approval?
options: It is automatically deleted pending review
It is reassigned to Monica Reyes
It is locked from further edits and Approval_Status__c is set to Pending Approval
Its Stage is automatically set to Closed Won
questions.explain: The initial submission actions lock the record and set Approval_Status__c to Pending Approval, so nobody edits Amount or Stage while the request is open.

questions.q: Why is Monica Reyes assigned as a specified-user approver instead of using a role-hierarchy-based approver like "submitter's manager"?
options: Specified-user approvers are required for every Salesforce approval process
Role-hierarchy-based approval isn't supported on the Opportunity object
The discount threshold applies the same way regardless of which branch of the hierarchy the Opportunity owner sits in, including Priya Nair, who doesn't report through Derek Oyelaran
Monica Reyes doesn't have a role in the hierarchy
questions.explain: Because Priya Nair reports directly to Monica while Tom Baptiste reports through Derek Oyelaran, a role-based approver wouldn't route both consistently to Monica -- naming her directly does.

questions.q: What happens when Monica Reyes rejects a discount request?
options: The Opportunity is permanently deleted
The record stays locked indefinitely
The record unlocks, Approval_Status__c is set to Rejected, and a Task is created telling the owner to revise and resubmit
The Discount Percent field is automatically reset to zero
questions.explain: The rejection actions unlock the record, set the status field, and create a follow-up Task for the Opportunity owner.

questions.q: Which two new fields does this lesson add to the Opportunity object?
options: Loss_Reason__c and Competing_Vendor__c
Primary_Contact__c and Target_Install_Quarter__c
Discount_Percent__c and Approval_Status__c
Business_Segment__c and Decision_Maker__c
questions.explain: Discount_Percent__c (what's proposed) and Approval_Status__c (where the request stands) are the two fields this lesson adds to support the approval process.
